resume: From acknowledging the child to choosing childcare: the administrative steps of the first months in Mayotte.

elements.detail: In Mayotte, apart from the birth registration, acknowledgment is done at the Mamoudzou town hall (mairie).

elements.titre: Know which benefits exist in Mayotte
elements.detail: The prime à la naissance (birth grant) and the Paje allocation de base (basic allowance) are not yet paid in Mayotte (expected from 2027 for the basic allowance, in 2029 for the grant).

elements.titre: Register the birth at the town hall (mairie)
Get or update the family record book (livret de famille)
Know how to get the child's birth certificate
elements.detail: It is free, and it will be requested for many procedures.

elements.titre: Register the baby with health insurance (CSSM, Mayotte's social security fund)
Add the baby to the top-up health insurance (mutuelle) or the C2S (Complémentaire santé solidaire)
Arrange check-ups and vaccinations (doctor or PMI, the mother and child health service)
Report the birth to the CSSM and check family allowances
elements.detail: In Mayotte, they are paid from the first child.
Places are scarce: plan ahead from pregnancy.

elements.titre: Open a savings account for the child
